source_text: Percutiet principes Moab; erit dominatus. Gloria regi Christo in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-strike princes of-Moab; there-will-be dominion. Glory to-king Christ into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: He shall strike Moab’s princes; dominion shall be his. Glory to Christ the king forever. Amen.
